name: study-problem-sets
description: Builds lesson-focused problem set PDFs from your own concept guide file(s), grades scanned handwritten answers against their answer key, solves screenshots of textbook pages with step-by-step solution PDFs, and builds SAT-style math practice sets scoped to any lesson range. Supports multiple concept guide files per folder (combined, with alias citations), and always asks before saving, with a ZIP-of-everything option. Works with any numbered-lesson textbook or course, not tied to a specific publisher or test organization.
